CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rsc_check_loss_inverse_seal_0159(checked_seal uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE s public.stock_loss_inverse_request_seals%ROWTYPE; root public.stock_loss_dispositions%ROWTYPE;
    parent public.stock_operation_orders%ROWTYPE; command jsonb; body jsonb; keys text[]; reference text;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO s FROM public.stock_loss_inverse_request_seals WHERE id=checked_seal;
    SELECT * INTO root FROM public.stock_loss_dispositions WHERE id=s.root_disposition_id;
    SELECT * INTO parent FROM public.stock_operation_orders WHERE id=root.operation_id;
    IF s.id IS NULL OR root.id IS NULL OR parent.id IS NULL OR parent.operation_type<>'loss_report'
       OR root.disposition NOT IN ('restore_available','convert_used','convert_damaged')
       OR s.authorization_version<1 OR s.created_at<root.created_at OR s.created_at>clock_timestamp()
       OR s.request_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,160}$' OR s.request_hash !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
       OR s.plan_hash !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' OR s.reversal_key_hash !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
       OR s.approval_key_hash !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' OR s.correction_key_hash !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
       OR s.idempotency_key_hash<>s.reversal_key_hash
       OR s.reversal_key_hash IN (s.approval_key_hash,s.correction_key_hash) OR s.approval_key_hash=s.correction_key_hash
       OR length(btrim(s.reason)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 OR btrim(s.reason)<>s.reason THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '0159 complete inverse seal context required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    command:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version',1,'action','reverse_loss','request_id',s.request_id,
        'expected_plan_hash',s.plan_hash,'intent',jsonb_build_object('root_disposition_id',root.id::text,
            'expected_root_request_hash',root.request_hash,'expected_submission_plan_hash',parent.plan_hash,
            'reversed_correction_id',NULL,'expected_execution_request_hash',root.request_hash,'reason',s.reason));
    IF s.command_jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM command
       OR public.rsc_canonical_reconciliation_json_0026(s.command_jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM
            public.rsc_canonical_reconciliation_json_0026(command)
       OR s.request_hash IS DISTINCT FROM
        encode(sha256(convert_to(public.rsc_canonical_reconciliation_json_0026(command),'UTF8')),'hex') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '0159 exact canonical inverse command required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    keys:=ARRAY[s.reversal_key_hash,s.approval_key_hash,s.correction_key_hash];
    reference:='inventory-request-'||encode(sha256(convert_to('cloud_oam.inventory.request.v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(s.request_id,'UTF8')),'hex');
    IF s.request_reference IS DISTINCT FROM reference
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_loss_inverse_request_seals other WHERE other.id<>s.id
            AND (other.reversal_key_hash=ANY(keys) OR other.approval_key_hash=ANY(keys) OR other.correction_key_hash=ANY(keys)
                OR (other.actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND other.request_id=s.request_id)))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_operation_orders WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys) OR (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_loss_dispositions WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys) OR (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_loss_regional_reviews WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys) OR (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_loss_headquarters_reviews WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys) OR (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_loss_request_seals WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys) OR (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_loss_review_request_seals WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys) OR (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_loss_disposition_request_seals WHERE (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_operation_cancellations WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys) OR (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_operation_command_seals WHERE (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_operation_outbounds WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys) OR (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_operation_shipments WHERE (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_operation_receipts WHERE (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_operation_return_inbounds WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys) OR (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_operation_return_inbound_seals WHERE (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_loss_disposition_reversals WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys) OR (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_loss_correction_decisions WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys) OR (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_loss_correction_executions WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys) OR (actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND request_id=s.request_id))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_transactions WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.shipments WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.receipts WHERE idempotency_key_hash=ANY(keys))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.audit_events WHERE actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id
            AND stream_key IN ('inventory','material_request') AND request_id IN (s.request_id,reference))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.state_transition_events WHERE actor_id=s.actor_user_id
            AND NOT (COALESCE(aggregate_type IN ('authentication_attempt','login_challenge','sms_dispatch','auth_session')
    AND metadata_jsonb->>'operation'='formal_authentication_state_transition'
    AND metadata_jsonb->>'request_id' ~ '^authreq-[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND metadata_jsonb->>'request_reference' IS NULL,false))
            AND (metadata_jsonb->>'request_id'=s.request_id OR metadata_jsonb->>'request_reference'=reference))
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.outbox_events WHERE payload_jsonb->>'actor_user_id'=s.actor_user_id
            AND payload_jsonb->>'request_id'=s.request_id)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.notification_events WHERE payload_jsonb->>'actor_user_id'=s.actor_user_id
            AND payload_jsonb->>'request_id'=s.request_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '0159 unknown or written inverse request cannot be sealed' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    body:=jsonb_build_object('root_disposition_id',root.id::text,'actor_user_id',s.actor_user_id,
        'actor_person_id',s.actor_person_id::text,'authorization_version',s.authorization_version,
        'request_id',s.request_id,'request_reference',reference,'reversal_key_hash',s.reversal_key_hash,
        'approval_key_hash',s.approval_key_hash,'correction_key_hash',s.correction_key_hash,
        'request_hash',s.request_hash,'plan_hash',s.plan_hash,'reason',s.reason,'command',command,'stock_effect','none');
    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.audit_events WHERE aggregate_type='stock_loss_inverse_request_seal'
            AND aggregate_id=s.id::text)<>1
       OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.audit_events WHERE aggregate_type='stock_loss_inverse_request_seal'
            AND ((actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND (after_jsonb->>'request_id'=s.request_id
                OR after_jsonb->>'request_reference'=reference))
                OR after_jsonb->>'reversal_key_hash'=ANY(keys) OR after_jsonb->>'approval_key_hash'=ANY(keys)
                OR after_jsonb->>'correction_key_hash'=ANY(keys)))<>1
       OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.audit_events WHERE stream_key='inventory'
            AND aggregate_type='stock_loss_inverse_request_seal' AND aggregate_id=s.id::text
            AND actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id AND action='stock_loss.inverse_request_sealed'
            AND request_id='loss-inverse-seal:'||s.id::text AND before_jsonb='{}'::jsonb AND after_jsonb=body
            AND public.rsc_canonical_reconciliation_json_0026(after_jsonb)=public.rsc_canonical_reconciliation_json_0026(body)
            AND created_at=s.created_at AND occurred_at=s.created_at)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.outbox_events WHERE aggregate_type='stock_loss_inverse_request_seal' AND aggregate_id=s.id::text)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.state_transition_events WHERE aggregate_type='stock_loss_inverse_request_seal' AND aggregate_id=s.id::text)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.notification_events WHERE business_type='stock_loss_inverse_request_seal' AND business_id=s.id::text) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '0159 exact stock-neutral inverse seal audit required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END;
